ReviewCard.influence: The prediction as it is minus the prediction without this review, in points of your scale
ReviewMatches.explanation: A review of this work and under it — a review of another work you marked. The number is how far the likeness is from chance, as with pictures; ✓ and ✕ — also as with pictures.
ReviewMatches.heading: Similar to reviews you marked
ReviewMatches.likeDrop: Similar to a review that would make you drop the work
ReviewMatches.likePick: Similar to a review that would make you pick the work
Reviews.explanationMark: Mark with 👍 or 👎 a review that says why you would pick the work or drop it — the model will look for similar ones in other works.
Reviews.explanationPoints: The number is how many points of your scale: the prediction as it is minus the prediction without this review.
